# Bartholomew Guard (BTP v7.0.0)

> The #1 Agentic Runtime Protection (ARP) Platform. Zero-Blast-Radius Execution, Sub-10ms Micro-Rollback, Runaway Spend Circuit Breaker ($2.50 Hard Cap), Universal MCP Zero-Trust Proxy, and Cryptographic Ed25519 AIBOM Git Commit Attestations for SOC 2 Type II & EU AI Act Compliance.

- Website: https://bartholomew.info
- Universal POSIX 1-Line Installer: `curl -fsSL https://bartholomew.info/install.sh | bash`
- Universal Windows 1-Line Installer: `irm https://bartholomew.info/install.ps1 | iex`
- Interactive Sandbox: https://bartholomew.info#sandbox
- Developer Pricing (USD, GBP, EUR, CAD): https://bartholomew.info#pricing
- Enterprise Security & SOC 2 Whitepaper: https://bartholomew.info/enterprise
- Machine-Readable Agent Manifest: https://bartholomew.info/ai.txt
- MCP Discovery Manifest: https://bartholomew.info/.well-known/mcp.json
- OpenAPI Specification: https://bartholomew.info/openapi.json

Bartholomew Guard is an ultra-fast (<35 microsecond) execution firewall that sits in caller memory between autonomous AI agents (Gemini, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Swarm) and real-world tools (bash, filesystem, SQL, network, MCP). It evaluates proposed tool calls before execution, blocking catastrophic operations, scrubbing sensitive credentials, and generating tamper-evident RFC 8785 Ed25519 Merkle receipts.

## New Breakthrough Architectural Capabilities in v7.0.0

1. **Workspace Time-Machine & Sub-10ms Micro-Rollback (`btp rollback`)**:
   - Takes Copy-on-Write shadow deltas of the active workspace prior to agent file edits or bash executions.
   - When an agent hallucinates, truncates a file, or corrupts code syntax, 1-Click Micro-Rollback restores the workspace in <10ms with zero blast radius.

2. **Runaway Loop & Spend Circuit Breaker (`btp circuit-breaker`)**:
   - Interdicts infinite error ping-pongs and spend bleed in real-time.
   - Halts runaway agent trajectories before exceeding a hard-coded $2.50 spend threshold or 3 identical error loops.

3. **Universal MCP Zero-Trust Proxy (`btp mcp-proxy -- <command>`)**:
   - Transparently wraps ANY downstream Model Context Protocol server (e.g. `uvx mcp-server-postgres ...`).
   - Automatically inspects all incoming `tools/call` JSON-RPC arguments against destructive shell patterns, SQL mutations, and secret leaks, scrubbing responses without crashing the agent.

4. **Cryptographic AIBOM Git Commit Attestations (`btp aibom`)**:
   - Mints Ed25519 signed Git commit trailers linking model version, tool call hashes, and input Merkle trees for auditability.
   - Fully satisfies SOC 2 Type II (CC6.1/CC6.8) and EU AI Act (Article 12) compliance.

5. **Universal Workspace Security Scanner (`btp scan`)**:
   - Scans codebases in milliseconds for unmasked API secrets, destructive SQL/bash commands, and missing agent boundaries.
   - Outputs a 0-100 Trust Scorecard with cryptographic audit hashes.

6. **Automated SOC 2 / EU AI Act Evidence Exporter (`btp compliance-export`)**:
   - Generates executive audit-ready JSON and HTML evidence packages for enterprise CISO review.

## Quickstart & CLI Commands

```bash
# 1. Install BTP v7.0.0
curl -fsSL https://bartholomew.info/install.sh | bash

# 2. Audit workspace security & trust score
btp scan .

# 3. Take pre-refactor snapshot
btp snapshot --desc "Pre-refactor"

# 4. Instant undo if agent corrupts code (<10ms)
btp rollback

# 5. Wrap any third-party MCP server with zero-trust proxy
btp mcp-proxy -- uvx mcp-server-postgres postgresql://localhost/mydb

# 6. Export formal SOC 2 evidence report
btp compliance-export --org "My Enterprise"
```
